title: Digital Graffiti
shortDescription: Visitors pick up a digital spray can and paint straight onto a large projected or screen wall, side by side and in real time. No mess, no skills needed, and every piece becomes a moment worth sharing.
longDescription: A large digital wall turns into a shared canvas: visitors grab a spray can and paint directly on the surface, with colour, spray texture, and drips appearing as they move. Several people can paint at once, so strangers end up co-creating a single piece, while solo visitors get a quick, satisfying creative moment. Backgrounds, colour palettes, brush styles, and stencils are configurable, so the wall can stay an open playground, follow a strict brand look, or frame a guided theme. Finished artworks can optionally be captured, shown on screen, or handed to visitors, and the setup scales from a single wall to a multi-wall street-art room. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Zero Learning Curve
highlights.description: Everyone knows how a spray can works, so kids, executives, and first-time visitors start painting within seconds, with no app and little or no instruction needed.

highlights.title: Built for Crowds
highlights.description: Several painters work on the same wall at once, and the growing artwork pulls in onlookers, making it a natural crowd magnet for booths, lobbies, and festival grounds.

highlights.title: From One Wall to a Whole Room
highlights.description: Start with a single screen or projection wall and expand to several walls for workshops, school groups, or a fully immersive graffiti room, all running on the same setup and content.

highlights.title: New Cans, New Rules
highlights.description: Add a stencil mode that reveals a logo or slogan as visitors spray, timed speed-painting challenges, artwork that animates once it is finished, or a live artist session that visitors join on the same wall.

highlights.title: Any Wall, Any World
highlights.description: Paint on a city brick wall for an urban festival, a frosted window for a winter edition, a museum facade for an art history story, or a backdrop in brand colours for a product launch.

highlights.title: Proof on the Wall
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts painters, sessions, and artworks created, and link take-home artworks to an opt-in email step so every saved piece doubles as a qualified lead.

highlights.title: Part of the Bigger Picture
highlights.description: Pair with Shared Gallery to stream finished pieces across the venue, with Photo Printing to hand out a print of each artwork, with Visitor Identificator to send painters their own piece, or with Journey Manager to make the wall one creative stop on a longer route.
